title: Rimegepant ODT Oral/Hypersensitivity FAERS Pipeline: disproportionality, machine learning, bridged network toxicology, and molecular docking
description: Four-layer, fully reproducible Python pipeline for post-marketing safety analysis of rimegepant orally disintegrating tablets using FAERS/AEMS 2020Q2–2026Q2 (25 quarters, N = 9,094,154 deduplicated cases; n = 8,962 primary-suspect cases). Layers: (1) four-algorithm disproportionality analysis (ROR, PRR, BCPNN, MGPS; BH-FDR) against a pre-specified five-subset oral/hypersensitivity composite endpoint; (2) machine-learning reporting-feature profiling (LR/RF/XGBoost/LightGBM, repeated 5×3 CV, SHAP, TRIPOD+AI); (3) bridged network toxicology (ChEMBL anchors → STRING BFS → Enrichr GO-BP/KEGG); (4) AutoDock Vina 1.2.5 molecular docking (CALCRL 6Z2V positive control; SYK 1A81 / BTK 1B55 off-target tests); plus a pre/post 2025Q3 label-revision notoriety-bias comparison.
